header.running_head: The Abstinence of Rasulullaah ﷺ and the Sahabah (RA) and How they Left the World Without Bothering About it

blocks.text: The Abstinence of Rasulullaah ﷺ and the Sahabah (RA) and How they Left the World Without Bothering About it
The Narration of Hadhrat Umar (RA) About the Imprint of a Mat on Rasulullaah ﷺ's Side

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) reports that Hadhrat Umar (RA) once told him about the time when he visited Rasulullaah ﷺ. Rasulullaah ﷺ was lying on a straw mat and when Hadhrat Umar (RA) sat down he noticed that Rasulullaah ﷺ because was not wearing an upper garment, the mat had made imprints on his side. Hadhrat Umar (RA) was also startled to see that all the room contained was a handful of barley close to a Saa in weight, some acacia leaves in one corner (used for dying cloth) and a piece of leather hanging. When tears started flowing from Hadhrat Umar (RA)'s eyes, Rasulullaah ﷺ asked, "What makes you weep, O son of Khattaab?" Hadhrat Umar (RA) replied, "O Nabi of Allaah ﷺ! Why should I not weep when the mat has left an imprint on your side and what I see here is the sum total of all your belongings? You are the Nabi of Allaah and His chosen servant and this is all you have whereas the Emperors of Rome and Persia have all types of fruits and rivers (and other luxuries)!" Rasulullaah ﷺ consoled him saying, "O son of Khattaab! Are you not satisfied that they should have the world while we have the Aakhirah?"[^1]

Another narration from Hadhrat Umar (RA) states, "I once sought permission to see Rasulullaah ﷺ. When I entered an upper storey room he was occupying, Rasulullaah ﷺ was lying on a coarse cloth with part of his body in the sand. His pillow was filled with the bark of a date palm, hanging over his head was a piece of leather and in a corner of the room lay some acacia leaves. After greeting Rasulullaah ﷺ and sitting down, I asked, "You are the Nabi of Allaah and His chosen servant (lying on a little coarse cloth) while the Emperors of Persia and Rome are sleeping on golden beds with bedding made of velvet and silk." Rasulullaah ﷺ replied, "Their luxuries have been brought to them in this world and will soon come to an end whereas our luxuries are postponed for the Aakhirah (and will never finish)."[^2]

According to yet another narration states that Hadhrat Umar (RA) once went to see Rasulullaah ﷺ. Rasulullaah ﷺ was lying down on a straw mat that had left an imprint on his side. Hadhrat Umar (RA) said, "O Rasulullaah ﷺ! Why do you rather not choose a softer bedding?" Rasulullaah ﷺ replied, "What

Haakim. Ibn Hibbaan has reported a similar narration from Hadhrat Anas (RA) who reports from Hadhrat Umar (RA), as quoted in Targheeb wat Tarheeb (Vol.5 Pg.161). Ahmad and Abu Ya'la have also reported the narration of Hadhrat Anas (RA) but Haythami (Vol.10 Pg.326) has commented on the chain of narrators in Imaam Ahmad's narration.
